payload.name: Extract_commitments_as_plan_memories
payload.description: When a speaker promises, offers, or agrees to perform a future action for another person, extract a plan memory even if the action has not yet happened.
content: During extraction, if a speaker promises, offers, or agrees to carry out a future action for another person (e.g., send, write, mail, bring, call, help), extract a candidate plan memory capturing the action, recipient, and topic/object, regardless of whether the action has occurred yet.
During CRUD, when such a commitment appears in the session or retrieved memories, create or update a plan memory; do not dismiss polite offers or future-tense statements as non-memorable.

solves: Construction pipelines often drop explicit commitments or offers to perform future actions, treating them as non-factual or merely polite statements. This leaves later questions about how something will be done unanswered. The rule applies to any speaker promise/offer/agreement to do a future action for someone else, across topics, and is bounded to action commitments rather than opinions or already-completed events.
